snippet.title: Benny's Backrooms - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Benny's Backrooms is a co-op multiplayer story game based on the Backrooms but with its own lore!
Wishlist on Steam https://rb.gy/jomm3k
Join for Updates and Feedback https://rb.gy/meisfx

Website https://rb.gy/l5pojz
X https://rb.gy/x5jvcj
Insta https://rb.gy/2hd0jd

A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.
